zh.title: 卖房前的房屋准备与装修：先做什么，什么可以不做
zh.seo_title: 卖房前准备与装修怎么排先后｜陈靖
zh.description: 卖房前不一定要大修。本文说明如何把清洁、维修、小更新和较大工程分开判断，加州请承包商要注意的执照和合同规定，以及 Disclosure、Permit 等常见问题，帮你按预算排先后。
zh.lead: 卖房前该花多少钱，答案取决于房子现状、预算和时间。先把问题列出来，再逐项判断，比直接开工稳妥。

en.title: Prep and Repairs Before Selling: What to Do First
en.seo_title: Home Prep and Repairs Before Selling | Jing Chen
en.description: Not every home needs a remodel before listing. Sort repairs by impact, cost and time, and know the California rules on contractors, permits and disclosure.
en.lead: What to spend before selling depends on your home, budget and timing. Listing the issues first and judging each one is safer than starting work right away.

sources.label: DRE：Disclosures in Real Property Transactions (2005 edition)
